arguments.description: Redesign this castle as a separate compact Citadel gatehouse: two squat unequal battlement towers flank one broad arched carriage entrance with a visible lowered iron portcullis. Weathered grey masonry, arrow slits, dark-blue slate caps and restrained red-gold pennants. Strong asymmetric gate silhouette, not a keep. Match source pixel density, shallow three-quarter view, upper-left light and selective outlines. Transparent; remove grassy base, road, scene and cast shadow.
